\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{ত্রাণ} (trān)}{ত্রাণ (trān)}]{\bn{ত্রাণ} (trān) — relief; aid}

\label{lesson:BN-C291-tran}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for homeless, then the Bengali for a helicopter.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{ত্রাণ}}
\textbf{\bn{ত্রাণ}} — \emph{trān} — \textquotedblleft{}relief; aid\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{নৌকায়} \bn{করে} \bn{গ্রামে} \bn{ত্রাণ} \bn{এল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{noukāy kôre grāme trān elô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Relief arrived in the village by boat.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{ত্রাণ}} (\emph{trān}) is Sanskrit \emph{trāṇa}, 'protecting, shelter, help' (Monier-Williams); in the news it is the food and goods sent to the victims of a disaster.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{trān}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{trān}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{noukāy kôre grāme trān elô.} — Relief arrived in the village by boat.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for homeless, then the Bengali for a helicopter, then say \emph{trān} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{ত্রাণ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Relief; aid\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{স্বেচ্ছাসেবক} (svechchhāsebôk)}{স্বেচ্ছাসেবক (svechchhāsebôk)}]{\bn{স্বেচ্ছাসেবক} (svechchhāsebôk) — a volunteer}

\label{lesson:BN-C291-svechchhasebok}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a helicopter, then the Bengali for disaster relief.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{স্বেচ্ছাসেবক}}
\textbf{\bn{স্বেচ্ছাসেবক}} — \emph{svechchhāsebôk} — \textquotedblleft{}a volunteer\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{কলেজের} \bn{ছাত্ররা} \bn{স্বেচ্ছাসেবক} \bn{হয়ে} \bn{ত্রাণের} \bn{কাজ} \bn{করল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{kôlejer chhātrôrā svechchhāsebôk hôye trāner kāj kôrlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
College students worked on the relief effort as volunteers.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{স্বেচ্ছাসেবক}} (\emph{svechchhāsebôk}) joins Sanskrit \emph{svecchā}, 'one's own free will' (Monier-Williams), to \emph{sevaka}, 'a servant': one who serves by choice.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{svechchhāsebôk}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{svechchhāsebôk}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kôlejer chhātrôrā svechchhāsebôk hôye trāner kāj kôrlô.} — College students worked on the relief effort as volunteers.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a helicopter, then the Bengali for disaster relief, then say \emph{svechchhāsebôk} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{স্বেচ্ছাসেবক} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A volunteer\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{শিবির} (shibir)}{শিবির (shibir)}]{\bn{শিবির} (shibir) — a camp}

\label{lesson:BN-C291-shibir}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for disaster relief, then the Bengali for a volunteer.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{শিবির}}
\textbf{\bn{শিবির}} — \emph{shibir} — \textquotedblleft{}a camp\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{শিবিরে} \bn{প্রতিদিন} \bn{দুই} \bn{হাজার} \bn{মানুষ} \bn{খাবার} \bn{পেত।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{shibire prôtidin dui hājār mānush khābār petô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Two thousand people got food at the camp every day.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{শিবির}} (\emph{shibir}) is Sanskrit \emph{śibira}, a royal camp or an army's tents (Monier-Williams); today it is any camp, from relief camps to medical camps.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shibir}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shibir}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shibire prôtidin dui hājār mānush khābār petô.} — Two thousand people got food at the camp every day.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for disaster relief, then the Bengali for a volunteer, then say \emph{shibir} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{শিবির} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A camp\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বিতরণ} \bn{করা} (bitôrôn kôrā)}{বিতরণ করা (bitôrôn kôrā)}]{\bn{বিতরণ} \bn{করা} (bitôrôn kôrā) — to hand out; to distribute}

\label{lesson:BN-C291-bitoron-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a volunteer, then the Bengali for a camp.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বিতরণ} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{বিতরণ} \bn{করা}} — \emph{bitôrôn kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to hand out; to distribute\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{স্বেচ্ছাসেবকরা} \bn{শিবিরে} \bn{চাল} \bn{আর} \bn{ডাল} \bn{বিতরণ} \bn{করল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{svechchhāsebôkrā shibire chāl ār ḍāl bitôrôn kôrlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The volunteers handed out rice and lentils at the camp.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{খাবার} \bn{বিতরণ} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini khābār bitôrôn kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বিতরণ} \bn{করা}} (\emph{bitôrôn kôrā}) puts Sanskrit \emph{vitaraṇa}, first 'a crossing over' and then 'a granting, a bestowal' (Monier-Williams), before \bn{করা}: to give out to many people.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bitôrôn kôrā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bitôrôn kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{svechchhāsebôkrā shibire chāl ār ḍāl bitôrôn kôrlô.} — The volunteers handed out rice and lentils at the camp.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a volunteer, then the Bengali for a camp, then say \emph{bitôrôn kôrā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{বিতরণ} \bn{করা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To hand out; to distribute\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{দান} \bn{করা} (dān kôrā)}{দান করা (dān kôrā)}]{\bn{দান} \bn{করা} (dān kôrā) — to donate; to give away}

\label{lesson:BN-C291-dan-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a camp, then the Bengali for to hand out.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{দান} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{দান} \bn{করা}} — \emph{dān kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to donate; to give away\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{গ্রামের} \bn{মানুষ} \bn{শিবিরে} \bn{কাপড়} \bn{আর} \bn{টাকা} \bn{দান} \bn{করল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{grāmer mānush shibire kāpôṛ ār ṭākā dān kôrlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The villagers donated clothes and money to the camp.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{অনেক} \bn{টাকা} \bn{দান} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini ônek ṭākā dān kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{দান} \bn{করা}} (\emph{dān kôrā}) puts Sanskrit \emph{dāna}, 'giving, a gift' (Monier-Williams), before \bn{করা}: to give for nothing in return.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling what happened.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dān kôrā}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{dān kôrā}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{grāmer mānush shibire kāpôṛ ār ṭākā dān kôrlô.} — The villagers donated clothes and money to the camp.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a camp, then the Bengali for to hand out, then say \emph{dān kôrā} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{দান} \bn{করা} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To donate; to give away\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from At the Police Station to Help Arrives}

\label{lesson:BN-R291-review-284-291}



\begin{quote}
Say the Bengali for to confess and a clue.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to confess, a clue, to guard, a prisoner, bail
  \item to threaten, a bribe, to frame, to loot, fraud
  \item to peep, to exhibit, strange, a shadow, to observe
  \item a moment, in an instant, to clutch, at once, to crash down
  \item a cyclone, a coast, to move forward, to uproot, electricity
  \item a tidal surge, to go under, high, a raft, to be flooded
  \item a wave, a riverbank, erosion, homeless, a helicopter
  \item disaster relief, a volunteer, a camp, to hand out, to donate
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To confess? (\textbf{\bn{কবুল} \bn{করা}}, \emph{kôbul kôrā}.) A clue? (\textbf{\bn{সূত্র}}, \emph{sūtrô}.) To guard? (\textbf{\bn{পাহারা} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{pāhārā deoyā}.) A prisoner? (\textbf{\bn{কয়েদি}}, \emph{kôyedi}.) Bail? (\textbf{\bn{জামিন}}, \emph{jāmin}.) To threaten? (\textbf{\bn{শাসানো}}, \emph{shāsāno}.) A bribe? (\textbf{\bn{ঘুষ}}, \emph{ghush}.) To frame? (\textbf{\bn{ফাঁসানো}}, \emph{phā̃sāno}.) To loot? (\textbf{\bn{লুট} \bn{করা}}, \emph{luṭ kôrā}.) Fraud? (\textbf{\bn{প্রতারণা}}, \emph{prôtārônā}.) To peep? (\textbf{\bn{উঁকি} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{ũki deoyā}.) To exhibit? (\textbf{\bn{প্রদর্শন} \bn{করা}}, \emph{prôdôrshôn kôrā}.) Strange? (\textbf{\bn{অদ্ভুত}}, \emph{ôdbhut}.) A shadow? (\textbf{\bn{ছায়া}}, \emph{chhāyā}.) To observe? (\textbf{\bn{লক্ষ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{lôkkhô kôrā}.) A moment? (\textbf{\bn{মুহূর্ত}}, \emph{muhūrtô}.) In an instant? (\textbf{\bn{চকিতে}}, \emph{chôkite}.) To clutch? (\textbf{\bn{আঁকড়ে} \bn{ধরা}}, \emph{ā̃kṛe dhôrā}.) At once? (\textbf{\bn{তৎক্ষণাৎ}}, \emph{tôtkkhônāt}.) To crash down? (\textbf{\bn{আছড়ে} \bn{পড়া}}, \emph{āchhṛe pôṛā}.) A cyclone? (\textbf{\bn{ঘূর্ণিঝড়}}, \emph{ghūrnijhôṛ}.) A coast? (\textbf{\bn{উপকূল}}, \emph{upôkūl}.) To move forward? (\textbf{\bn{এগোনো}}, \emph{egono}.) To uproot? (\textbf{\bn{উপড়ানো}}, \emph{upṛāno}.) Electricity? (\textbf{\bn{বিদ্যুৎ}}, \emph{bidyut}.) A tidal surge? (\textbf{\bn{জলোচ্ছ্বাস}}, \emph{jôlochchhvās}.) To go under? (\textbf{\bn{তলিয়ে} \bn{যাওয়া}}, \emph{tôliye jāoyā}.) High? (\textbf{\bn{উঁচু}}, \emph{ũchu}.) A raft? (\textbf{\bn{ভেলা}}, \emph{bhelā}.) To be flooded? (\textbf{\bn{প্লাবিত} \bn{হওয়া}}, \emph{plābitô hôoyā}.) A wave? (\textbf{\bn{ঢেউ}}, \emph{ḍheu}.) A riverbank? (\textbf{\bn{তীর}}, \emph{tīr}.) Erosion? (\textbf{\bn{ভাঙন}}, \emph{bhāngôn}.) Homeless? (\textbf{\bn{গৃহহীন}}, \emph{grihôhīn}.) A helicopter? (\textbf{\bn{হেলিকপ্টার}}, \emph{helikôpṭār}.) Disaster relief? (\textbf{\bn{ত্রাণ}}, \emph{trān}.) A volunteer? (\textbf{\bn{স্বেচ্ছাসেবক}}, \emph{svechchhāsebôk}.) A camp? (\textbf{\bn{শিবির}}, \emph{shibir}.) To hand out? (\textbf{\bn{বিতরণ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{bitôrôn kôrā}.) To donate? (\textbf{\bn{দান} \bn{করা}}, \emph{dān kôrā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
